`Retry-After`. Keyed `409` errors retry only when
`details.idempotency_outcome` is `in_progress`. An `unknown` outcome requires
reading/reconciling the resource before any further mutation.

## Pagination

List endpoints are cursor-paginated. Use `list()` for a single page or
`listAll()` to walk every page with `for await`:

```ts
const page = await vatly.orders.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const order of vatly.orders.listAll({ limit: 100 })) {
  // ...
}
```

## Resources

The SDK provides access to all Vatly API resources. The complete method and
return-type inventory is in the [operation reference](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/api).

| Resource                                                                           | Description                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| [Checkouts](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/checkouts)                  | Create hosted payment pages                           |
| [Customers](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/customers)                  | Manage customer records                               |
| [Subscriptions](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/subscriptions)          | Recurring billing                                     |
| [Subscription Plans](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/subscriptionplans) | Define subscription products                          |
| [One-Off Products](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/oneoffproducts)      | Single-purchase products                              |
| [Orders](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/orders)                        | Transaction records                                   |
| [Refunds](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/refunds)                      | Process refunds                                       |
| [Chargebacks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/chargebacks)              | Handle disputes                                       |
| [Webhooks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/webhooks)                    | Endpoint management and real-time event notifications |

## Error handling

Every non-2xx response maps to a typed error extending `VatlyError`.

| Name                                         | Status | Description                                                   |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VatlyAuthError`                             | `401`  | Missing or invalid API key.                                   |
| `VatlyForbiddenError`                        | `403`  | Authenticated but not allowed.                                |
| `VatlyNotFoundError`                         | `404`  | Resource does not exist.                                      |
| `VatlyConflictError`                         | `409`  | Conflict; inspect `.details` and `.retryAfter`.               |
| `VatlyValidationError`                       | `422`  | Invalid request; exposes `.errors: Record<string, string[]>`. |
| `VatlyRateLimitError`                        | `429`  | Rate limited; exposes `.retryAfter` (seconds).                |
| `VatlyApiError`                              | other  | Any other API error.                                          |
| `VatlyConnectionError` / `VatlyTimeoutError` | —      | Network failure / timeout.                                    |

Errors include the request method and URL. Resource and list methods also raise
`VatlyApiError` for malformed JSON, empty bodies, unexpected 204 responses, or
JSON `null`. Documented no-content operations accept empty success responses;
other resource fields are not runtime schema-validated.

```ts
import { VatlyValidationError } from "@getvatly/sdk";

try {
  await vatly.customers.create({ email: "" });
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof VatlyValidationError) {
    console.error(err.errors.email);
  } else {
    throw err;
  }
}
```

## Money

Monetary amounts are `Money` objects — `{ value, currency }` where `value` is a
**decimal string** to preserve precision. Never coerce `value` to a JavaScript
`number`. Helpers convert to/from integer minor units:

```ts
import { toMinorUnits, fromMinorUnits } from "@getvatly/sdk";

toMinorUnits({ value: "29.00", currency: "EUR" }); // → 2900n
fromMinorUnits(2900n, "EUR");                       // → { value: "29.00", currency: "EUR" }
```

## Requirements

- Node 20+, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno, or Bun
- Platform `fetch` and Web Crypto (built in on all supported runtimes)


# Customers

Customers represent the end users who purchase products through Vatly.

For all fields and options, see the [Customers API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/customers){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Customer resource

| Name        | Type            | Description                                         |
| ----------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`        | `string`        | Unique identifier for the customer (`customer_…`).  |
| `resource`  | `string`        | Always `customer`.                                  |
| `email`     | `string`        | Customer's email address (ASCII / Punycode domain). |
| `metadata`  | `object | null` | Your custom key/value metadata.                     |
| `createdAt` | `string`        | Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).                      |
| `testmode`  | `boolean`       | Whether this is a test customer.                    |

## Create a customer

`POST /v1/customers`

### Required attributes

| Name    | Type     | Description                   |
| ------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `email` | `string` | The customer's email address. |

### Optional attributes

| Name       | Type     | Description                |
| ---------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| `metadata` | `object` | Custom key/value metadata. |

```ts
const customer = await vatly.customers.create({
  email: "ada@example.com",
  metadata: { plan: "pro" },
});
```

Unicode domains are accepted directly; Vatly lowercases the local part and
canonicalizes the domain to lowercase Punycode. Creating an already-known email
returns the existing customer unchanged. To encode a domain yourself, optionally use:

```ts
import { encodeEmail } from "@getvatly/sdk";

encodeEmail("user@bücher.de"); // → "user@xn--bcher-kva.de"
```

## Retrieve a customer

`GET /v1/customers/{customerId}`

```ts
const customer = await vatly.customers.get("customer_abc123");
```

## Update identity and open the hosted portal

```ts
await vatly.customers.update("customer_abc123", { name: "Ada", email: "ada@example.com" });
const session = await vatly.customers.createPortalSession("customer_abc123", {
  returnUrl: "https://yourapp.com/account",
});
// Redirect the customer's browser to session.url. It is short-lived and single-use.
```

Updates accept name/email, not billing addresses. Portal settings are optional;
`returnUrl` must be an absolute HTTPS URL without credentials, sent in the JSON
body (not query params), at most 2,048 UTF-8 bytes. Authenticate your own customer
before issuing a portal session, and never log or persist its credential URL.

## List customers

`GET /v1/customers`

```ts
const page = await vatly.customers.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const customer of vatly.customers.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

## A customer's subscriptions

`GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/subscriptions`

```ts
// One page:
const page = await vatly.customers.listSubscriptions("customer_abc123", { limit: 10 });

// Every subscription:
for await (const sub of vatly.customers.listAllSubscriptions("customer_abc123")) {
  // ...
}

// A single nested subscription:
const sub = await vatly.customers.getSubscription("customer_abc123", "subscription_abc123");
```


# SDK operation reference

Import `VatlyClient` from `@getvatly/sdk`. All paths below are relative to `/v1`.
Every method takes optional `RequestOptions` last. For field details, see the
[API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}; the [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}
is also available for tooling. Bodies and results use generated types; server-side validation still applies.
Types, `components`, `paths`, and `operations` are exported from the package root.

| SDK method                                        | HTTP   | Path                                                    | Result                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `checkouts.list(params?)`                         | GET    | `/checkouts`                                            | Page of Checkout                               |
| `checkouts.create(body)`                          | POST   | `/checkouts`                                            | Checkout                                       |
| `checkouts.get(id)`                               | GET    | `/checkouts/{id}`                                       | Checkout                                       |
| `customers.list(params?)`                         | GET    | `/customers`                                            | Page of Customer                               |
| `customers.create(body)`                          | POST   | `/customers`                                            | Customer (new or existing)                     |
| `customers.get(id)`                               | GET    | `/customers/{id}`                                       | Customer                                       |
| `customers.update(id, body)`                      | PATCH  | `/customers/{id}`                                       | Customer                                       |
| `customers.createPortalSession(id, body?)`        | POST   | `/customers/{id}/portal-sessions`                       | PortalSession                                  |
| `customers.listSubscriptions(id, params?)`        | GET    | `/customers/{id}/subscriptions`                         | Page of Subscription                           |
| `customers.getSubscription(id, subId)`            | GET    | `/customers/{id}/subscriptions/{subId}`                 | Subscription                                   |
| `oneOffProducts.list(params?)`                    | GET    | `/one-off-products`                                     | Page of OneOffProduct                          |
| `oneOffProducts.create(body)`                     | POST   | `/one-off-products`                                     | OneOffProduct                                  |
| `oneOffProducts.get(id)`                          | GET    | `/one-off-products/{id}`                                | OneOffProduct                                  |
| `oneOffProducts.update(id, body)`                 | PATCH  | `/one-off-products/{id}`                                | OneOffProduct                                  |
| `oneOffProducts.archive(id)`                      | POST   | `/one-off-products/{id}/archive`                        | void (204)                                     |
| `oneOffProducts.unarchive(id)`                    | DELETE | `/one-off-products/{id}/archive`                        | OneOffProduct                                  |
| `subscriptionPlans.list(params?)`                 | GET    | `/subscription-plans`                                   | Page of SubscriptionPlan                       |
| `subscriptionPlans.create(body)`                  | POST   | `/subscription-plans`                                   | SubscriptionPlan                               |
| `subscriptionPlans.get(id)`                       | GET    | `/subscription-plans/{id}`                              | SubscriptionPlan                               |
| `subscriptionPlans.update(id, body)`              | PATCH  | `/subscription-plans/{id}`                              | SubscriptionPlan                               |
| `subscriptionPlans.archive(id)`                   | POST   | `/subscription-plans/{id}/archive`                      | void (204)                                     |
| `subscriptionPlans.unarchive(id)`                 | DELETE | `/subscription-plans/{id}/archive`                      | SubscriptionPlan                               |
| `orders.list(params?)`                            | GET    | `/orders`                                               | Page of Order                                  |
| `orders.get(id)`                                  | GET    | `/orders/{id}`                                          | Order                                          |
| `orders.createInvoiceUpdateLink(id)`              | POST   | `/orders/{id}/invoice-update-link`                      | InvoiceUpdateLink (`href`, `type`)             |
| `orders.listRefunds(id, params?)`                 | GET    | `/orders/{id}/refunds`                                  | Page of Refund                                 |
| `orders.createRefund(id, body)`                   | POST   | `/orders/{id}/refunds`                                  | Refund                                         |
| `orders.createFullRefund(id, body?)`              | POST   | `/orders/{id}/refunds/full`                             | Refund                                         |
| `orders.getRefund(id, refundId)`                  | GET    | `/orders/{id}/refunds/{refundId}`                       | Refund                                         |
| `orders.cancelRefund(id, refundId)`               | DELETE | `/orders/{id}/refunds/{refundId}`                       | void (204)                                     |
| `orders.listChargebacks(id, params?)`             | GET    | `/orders/{id}/chargebacks`                              | Page of Chargeback                             |
| `orders.getChargeback(id, chargebackId)`          | GET    | `/orders/{id}/chargebacks/{chargebackId}`               | Chargeback                                     |
| `refunds.list(params?)`                           | GET    | `/refunds`                                              | Page of Refund                                 |
| `refunds.get(id)`                                 | GET    | `/refunds/{id}`                                         | Refund                                         |
| `chargebacks.list(params?)`                       | GET    | `/chargebacks`                                          | Page of Chargeback                             |
| `chargebacks.get(id)`                             | GET    | `/chargebacks/{id}`                                     | Chargeback                                     |
| `webhookEvents.get(id)`                           | GET    | `/webhook-events/{id}`                                  | WebhookEvent                                   |
| `webhookEndpoints.list(params?)`                  | GET    | `/webhook-endpoints`                                    | Page of WebhookEndpoint                        |
| `webhookEndpoints.create(body)`                   | POST   | `/webhook-endpoints`                                    | WebhookEndpoint                                |
| `webhookEndpoints.get(id)`                        | GET    | `/webhook-endpoints/{id}`                               | WebhookEndpoint                                |
| `webhookEndpoints.update(id, body)`               | PATCH  | `/webhook-endpoints/{id}`                               | WebhookEndpoint                                |
| `webhookEndpoints.delete(id)`                     | DELETE | `/webhook-endpoints/{id}`                               | void (204)                                     |
| `subscriptions.list(params?)`                     | GET    | `/subscriptions`                                        | Page of Subscription                           |
| `subscriptions.get(id)`                           | GET    | `/subscriptions/{id}`                                   | Subscription                                   |
| `subscriptions.update(id, body)`                  | PATCH  | `/subscriptions/{id}`                                   | Subscription                                   |
| `subscriptions.cancel(id)`                        | DELETE | `/subscriptions/{id}`                                   | void (204)                                     |
| `subscriptions.createBillingUpdateLink(id, body)` | POST   | `/subscriptions/{id}/billing-update-link`               | SubscriptionBillingUpdateLink (`href`, `type`) |
| `subscriptions.resume(id)`                        | POST   | `/subscriptions/{id}/resume`                            | Subscription                                   |
| `testHelpers.fastForwardRenewal(id, body?)`       | POST   | `/test-helpers/subscriptions/{id}/fast-forward-renewal` | Subscription                                   |
| `testHelpers.simulateOrderPayment(id, body)`      | POST   | `/test-helpers/orders/{id}/simulate-payment`            | Order                                          |

All top-level lists have a `listAll(params?, opts?)` async iterator. Nested
subscription/refund lists have `listAllSubscriptions` / `listAllRefunds`.
Pagination params: `limit`, `startingAfter`, `endingBefore`. Product/plan lists
also accept `includeArchived`. Immediate cancellation uses
`subscriptions.cancel(id, { immediately: true, ...requestOptions })`.

## Alpha migration notes

- Package scope changed to `@getvatly/sdk` (also `@getvatly/sdk/webhooks`).
- Cancellation now accurately returns `Promise<void>`, not a subscription.
  Fetch the subscription afterward if needed.
- Billing-update methods now return a hosted link, not a subscription.
  Deprecated `updateBilling` / `requestAddressUpdateLink` aliases still work.
- The obsolete `simulatePaymentFailure(transactionId)` endpoint is removed;
  use `simulateOrderPayment(orderId, { paymentStatus: "failed" })`.
- `fastForwardRenewal` now takes an optional body second and options third.
- Optional fields with server defaults no longer need to be supplied in requests.
- Errors can expose `details`; only `in_progress` idempotency conflicts retry.
- Subscription updates require at least one of `subscriptionPlanId`, `price`,
  or `quantity`; `trialUntil` cannot stand alone. This is validated by the API.

## Deterministic payment testing

Only test-mode keys are allowed (guarded before sending a request):

```ts
const subscription = await vatly.testHelpers.fastForwardRenewal("subscription_123", {
  paymentStatus: "failed",
  failureReason: "card_expired",
});
const order = await vatly.testHelpers.simulateOrderPayment("order_123", {
  paymentStatus: "paid",
});
```

Omitting the renewal body advances the cycle and leaves its payment pending.
`failureReason` only applies with `paymentStatus: "failed"`.
These operations simulate payment outcomes; payment recovery remains managed
by Vatly. See the [testing guide](https://docs.vatly.com/guides/testing){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} for
recovery timelines and event semantics.


# Checkouts

Checkouts create hosted payment pages for your customers. When a checkout completes successfully, an Order is created.

For all fields and options, see the [Checkouts API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/checkouts){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Checkout resource

| Name                  | Type            | Description                                            |
| --------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                  | `string`        | Unique identifier for the checkout (`checkout_…`).     |
| `resource`            | `string`        | Always `checkout`.                                     |
| `status`              | `string`        | `created`, `paid`, `canceled`, `failed`, or `expired`. |
| `customerId`          | `string | null` | The customer this checkout is for, if known.           |
| `orderId`             | `string | null` | Order ID, available after successful payment.          |
| `redirectUrlSuccess`  | `string`        | Where the customer returns on success.                 |
| `redirectUrlCanceled` | `string`        | Where the customer returns on cancel.                  |
| `metadata`            | `object | null` | Your custom key/value metadata.                        |
| `expiresAt`           | `string | null` | Expiration timestamp (ISO 8601).                       |
| `createdAt`           | `string`        | Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).                         |
| `testmode`            | `boolean`       | Whether this is a test checkout.                       |
| `links.checkoutUrl`   | `Link`          | The hosted page to send the customer to.               |

## Create a checkout

`POST /v1/checkouts`

### Required attributes

| Name                  | Type     | Description                                                                                                              |
| --------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `products`            | `array`  | Product items to sell. Each item is `{ id, quantity }`, where `id` is a `subscription_plan_…` or `one_off_product_…` id. |
| `redirectUrlSuccess`  | `string` | Success redirect URL.                                                                                                    |
| `redirectUrlCanceled` | `string` | Cancel redirect URL.                                                                                                     |

### Optional attributes

| Name         | Type     | Description                                                      |
| ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `customerId` | `string` | Attach the checkout to an existing customer.                     |
| `metadata`   | `object` | Custom metadata echoed back on the checkout and resulting order. |

```ts
const checkout = await vatly.checkouts.create({
  redirectUrlSuccess: "https://yourapp.com/success",
  redirectUrlCanceled: "https://yourapp.com/canceled",
  products: [{ id: "subscription_plan_abc123", quantity: 1 }],
  customerId: "customer_abc123",
  metadata: { signupId: "su_42" },
});

// Send the customer here:
redirect(checkout.links.checkoutUrl.href);
```

## Retrieve a checkout

`GET /v1/checkouts/{checkoutId}`

```ts
const checkout = await vatly.checkouts.get("checkout_abc123");
```

## List checkouts

`GET /v1/checkouts`

```ts
const page = await vatly.checkouts.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const checkout of vatly.checkouts.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```


# Subscriptions

Subscriptions are recurring billing relationships. They renew automatically according to their plan's interval until canceled.

For all fields and options, see the [Subscriptions API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/subscriptions){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Subscription resource

| Name                                   | Type                | Description                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                                   | `string`            | Unique identifier (`subscription_…`).                                              |
| `customerId`                           | `string`            | The customer this subscription belongs to.                                         |
| `subscriptionPlanId`                   | `string`            | The plan this subscription is based on.                                            |
| `name`                                 | `string`            | Display name.                                                                      |
| `quantity`                             | `number`            | Number of units.                                                                   |
| `status`                               | `string`            | `active`, `created`, `trial`, `on_grace_period`, `paused`, or `canceled`.          |
| `interval` / `intervalCount`           | `string` / `number` | Billing cadence (e.g. `month` × 1).                                                |
| `mandate`                              | `Mandate | null`    | Payment method on file: `{ method, maskedIdentifier }`. `null` until one is bound. |
| `startedAt` / `endedAt` / `canceledAt` | `string | null`     | Lifecycle timestamps (ISO 8601).                                                   |
| `nextRenewalAt` / `renewedUntil`       | `string | null`     | Renewal timestamps.                                                                |
| `testmode`                             | `boolean`           | Whether this is a test subscription.                                               |

## Retrieve a subscription

`GET /v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}`

```ts
const subscription = await vatly.subscriptions.get("subscription_abc123");
console.log(subscription.mandate?.maskedIdentifier);
```

## List subscriptions

`GET /v1/subscriptions`

```ts
const page = await vatly.subscriptions.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const sub of vatly.subscriptions.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

## Update a subscription

`PATCH /v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}`

Common attributes: `quantity`, `subscriptionPlanId` (plan change), `prorate`,
`applyImmediately`, `trialUntil`. Include at least one of `subscriptionPlanId`,
`price`, or `quantity`; `trialUntil` cannot be sent alone. See the
[API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/subscriptions){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} for all options.

```ts
const subscription = await vatly.subscriptions.update("subscription_abc123", {
  quantity: 2,
});
```

## Cancel a subscription

`DELETE /v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}` (204: no return value)

```ts
await vatly.subscriptions.cancel("subscription_abc123"); // period end
await vatly.subscriptions.cancel("subscription_other", { immediately: true });
```

The default schedules cancellation at period end (with a grace period);
`immediately: true` cancels immediately. Listen for the
`subscription.canceled_*` webhooks to react.

## Resume a subscription

`POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resume`

Resume a subscription that was canceled with a grace period, while that grace
period is still active.

```ts
const subscription = await vatly.subscriptions.resume("subscription_abc123");
```

## Update billing details (hosted link)

`POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/billing-update-link`

Returns a hosted link where the customer can update their payment method
(mandate) or billing address. Redirect the customer to it.

```ts
const link = await vatly.subscriptions.createBillingUpdateLink("subscription_abc123", {
  redirectUrlSuccess: "https://yourapp.com/billing/updated",
  redirectUrlCanceled: "https://yourapp.com/billing",
});
redirect(link.href);
```

When the mandate changes, Vatly emits a `subscription.billing_updated` webhook so
you can refresh the masked payment method shown to the customer.


# Subscription Plans

Subscription plans define recurring products, prices, and billing intervals.
The API supports creation, updates, archive and unarchive.

For all fields and options, see the [Subscription Plans API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/subscription-plans){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Subscription Plan resource

| Name                         | Type                | Description                                                                    |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                         | `string`            | Unique identifier (`subscription_plan_…`).                                     |
| `resource`                   | `string`            | Always `subscription_plan`.                                                    |
| `name`                       | `string`            | Display name.                                                                  |
| `description`                | `string | null`     | Optional description.                                                          |
| `basePrice`                  | `Money`             | Price per interval, e.g. `{ value: "29.00", currency: "EUR" }`.                |
| `interval` / `intervalCount` | `string` / `number` | Billing cadence (e.g. `month` × 1).                                            |
| `status`                     | `string`            | `active`, `pending`, or `rejected`. Archive state is separate in `archivedAt`. |
| `createdAt`                  | `string`            | Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).                                                 |
| `testmode`                   | `boolean`           | Whether this is a test plan.                                                   |

## Retrieve a subscription plan

`GET /v1/subscription-plans/{subscriptionPlanId}`

```ts
const plan = await vatly.subscriptionPlans.get("subscription_plan_abc123");
console.log(plan.basePrice.value, plan.basePrice.currency);
```

## List subscription plans

`GET /v1/subscription-plans`

```ts
const page = await vatly.subscriptionPlans.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const plan of vatly.subscriptionPlans.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

To sell a plan, pass its `id` in a [checkout](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/checkouts)'s `products`.

## Create, update and archive

```ts
const plan = await vatly.subscriptionPlans.create({
  name: "Pro Monthly", description: "Pro features", productType: "saas",
  basePrice: { value: "29.00", currency: "EUR" }, interval: "month", intervalCount: 1,
});
await vatly.subscriptionPlans.update(plan.id, { interval: "week", intervalCount: 2 });
await vatly.subscriptionPlans.archive(plan.id); // 204: no return value
const restored = await vatly.subscriptionPlans.unarchive(plan.id);
const all = await vatly.subscriptionPlans.list({ includeArchived: true });
```

New prices are EUR-only. `taxBehavior` defaults to `exclusive` and is immutable.
Plans sell `saas` only; `day` intervals are test-mode-only. Creation and updates
may require approval; inspect `status`, `pendingUpdates`, and `updateStatus`.


# Orders

Orders record checkout purchases and subscription renewals, including pending payments. They carry invoice links and tax breakdowns, and let you create refunds and inspect chargebacks.

For all fields and options, see the [Orders API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/orders){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Order resource

| Name                 | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                |
| -------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`                 | `string`        | Unique identifier (`order_…`).                                                                                                             |
| `customerId`         | `string | null` | The customer this order belongs to.                                                                                                        |
| `status`             | `string`        | `created`, `pending`, `paid`, `canceled`, or `expired`. Payment recovery is signaled by `order.payment_failed`, not a status of that name. |
| `total`              | `Money`         | Gross amount (incl. tax).                                                                                                                  |
| `subtotal`           | `Money`         | Net amount (excl. tax).                                                                                                                    |
| `reversedSubtotal`   | `Money`         | Net amount already reversed via refunds/chargebacks.                                                                                       |
| `refundableSubtotal` | `Money`         | Net amount still refundable.                                                                                                               |
| `taxSummary`         | `array`         | Per-rate VAT breakdown.                                                                                                                    |
| `lines`              | `OrderLine[]`   | Line items, incl. `productType` / `productId`.                                                                                             |
| `invoiceNumber`      | `string | null` | Assigned once the invoice is issued.                                                                                                       |
| `paymentMethod`      | `string | null` | Payment method used.                                                                                                                       |
| `metadata`           | `object | null` | Custom metadata carried from the checkout.                                                                                                 |
| `testmode`           | `boolean`       | Whether this is a test order.                                                                                                              |

## Retrieve an order

`GET /v1/orders/{orderId}`

```ts
const order = await vatly.orders.get("order_abc123");
console.log(order.total.value, order.total.currency);
```

## List orders

`GET /v1/orders`

```ts
const page = await vatly.orders.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const order of vatly.orders.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

## Invoice update link (hosted)

`POST /v1/orders/{orderId}/invoice-update-link`

Returns a hosted link where the customer can correct their invoice details
(billing address, VAT number, company name).

```ts
const link = await vatly.orders.createInvoiceUpdateLink("order_abc123");
redirect(link.href);
```

## Refunds on an order

Refunds are created against the order they belong to.

```ts
// Partial refund of specific items:
const refund = await vatly.orders.createRefund("order_abc123", {
  items: [
    { itemId: "order_item_abc123", amount: { value: "15.00", currency: "EUR" } },
  ],
});

// Full refund of the entire order:
const full = await vatly.orders.createFullRefund("order_abc123");

// List / get / cancel:
const page = await vatly.orders.listRefunds("order_abc123", { limit: 10 });
for await (const r of vatly.orders.listAllRefunds("order_abc123")) {
  // ...
}
const one = await vatly.orders.getRefund("order_abc123", "refund_abc123");
await vatly.orders.cancelRefund("order_abc123", "refund_abc123"); // only while pending
```

See [Refunds](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/refunds) for the top-level refund endpoints.

## Chargebacks on an order

```ts
const page = await vatly.orders.listChargebacks("order_abc123");
const chargeback = await vatly.orders.getChargeback("order_abc123", "chargeback_abc123");
```

See [Chargebacks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/chargebacks) for the top-level chargeback endpoints.


# Refunds

A refund returns funds to a customer for an order. Refunds are **created** against an order (see [Orders](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/orders#refunds-on-an-order)); the top-level `refunds` resource lets you list and retrieve them across all orders.

For all fields and options, see the [Refunds API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/global-refunds){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} and [creating order refunds](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/refunds){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Refund resource

| Name              | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`              | `string`  | Unique identifier (`refund_…`).                                                                                                                |
| `customerId`      | `string`  | The customer being refunded.                                                                                                                   |
| `originalOrderId` | `string`  | The order this refund is against.                                                                                                              |
| `status`          | `string`  | `pending`, `queued`, `processing`, `refunded`, `failed`, or `canceled`. The success event is `refund.completed`, but the status is `refunded`. |
| `total`           | `Money`   | Gross amount refunded (incl. tax).                                                                                                             |
| `subtotal`        | `Money`   | Net amount refunded (excl. tax).                                                                                                               |
| `taxSummary`      | `array`   | Per-rate VAT breakdown of the refund.                                                                                                          |
| `testmode`        | `boolean` | Whether this is a test refund.                                                                                                                 |

## Retrieve a refund

`GET /v1/refunds/{refundId}`

```ts
const refund = await vatly.refunds.get("refund_abc123");
```

## List refunds

`GET /v1/refunds`

```ts
const page = await vatly.refunds.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const refund of vatly.refunds.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

## Creating refunds

Create refunds against an order with `orders.createRefund` / `orders.createFullRefund`:

```ts
await vatly.orders.createRefund("order_abc123", {
  items: [{ itemId: "order_item_abc123", amount: { value: "15.00", currency: "EUR" } }],
});

await vatly.orders.createFullRefund("order_abc123");
```

Listen for the `refund.completed` / `refund.failed` / `refund.canceled` webhooks
to reconcile your local records — the webhook payload carries the full tax
breakdown, so no follow-up call is needed.


# One-Off Products

One-off products are single-purchase items (no recurring billing). They can be
created, updated, archived, and unarchived through the API.

For all fields and options, see the [One-off Products API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/one-off-products){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The One-Off Product resource

| Name          | Type            | Description                                                                    |
| ------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`          | `string`        | Unique identifier (`one_off_product_…`).                                       |
| `resource`    | `string`        | Always `one_off_product`.                                                      |
| `name`        | `string`        | Display name.                                                                  |
| `description` | `string | null` | Optional description.                                                          |
| `basePrice`   | `Money`         | Price, e.g. `{ value: "49.00", currency: "EUR" }`.                             |
| `status`      | `string`        | `active`, `pending`, or `rejected`. Archive state is separate in `archivedAt`. |
| `createdAt`   | `string`        | Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).                                                 |
| `testmode`    | `boolean`       | Whether this is a test product.                                                |

## Retrieve a one-off product

`GET /v1/one-off-products/{oneOffProductId}`

```ts
const product = await vatly.oneOffProducts.get("one_off_product_abc123");
```

## List one-off products

`GET /v1/one-off-products`

```ts
const page = await vatly.oneOffProducts.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const product of vatly.oneOffProducts.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

To sell a one-off product, pass its `id` in a [checkout](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/checkouts)'s `products`.

## Create, update and archive

```ts
const product = await vatly.oneOffProducts.create({
  name: "Premium License", description: "Lifetime access", productType: "saas",
  basePrice: { value: "99.00", currency: "EUR" }, taxBehavior: "exclusive",
});
await vatly.oneOffProducts.update(product.id, { name: "Premium License v2" });
await vatly.oneOffProducts.archive(product.id); // 204: no return value
const restored = await vatly.oneOffProducts.unarchive(product.id);
const all = await vatly.oneOffProducts.list({ includeArchived: true });
```

`productType` is `saas` or `ebook`. Creation and updates may require approval;
inspect `status`, `pendingUpdates`, and `updateStatus` rather than assuming the
requested values are already live. `taxBehavior` is immutable after creation.


# Chargebacks

A chargeback is a payment dispute raised by the cardholder's bank against an order. Vatly records it (and any later reversal) so you can suspend access and reconcile the reversed VAT.

For all fields and options, see the [Chargebacks API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/chargebacks){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## The Chargeback resource

| Name              | Type            | Description                         |
| ----------------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `id`              | `string`        | Unique identifier (`chargeback_…`). |
| `customerId`      | `string`        | The customer who disputed.          |
| `originalOrderId` | `string`        | The order being disputed.           |
| `status`          | `string`        | Dispute status.                     |
| `reason`          | `string | null` | Reason given, if any.               |
| `total`           | `Money`         | Gross amount disputed (incl. tax).  |
| `subtotal`        | `Money`         | Net amount disputed (excl. tax).    |
| `taxSummary`      | `array`         | Per-rate VAT breakdown.             |
| `testmode`        | `boolean`       | Whether this is a test chargeback.  |

## Retrieve a chargeback

`GET /v1/chargebacks/{chargebackId}`

```ts
const chargeback = await vatly.chargebacks.get("chargeback_abc123");
```

## List chargebacks

`GET /v1/chargebacks`

```ts
const page = await vatly.chargebacks.list({ limit: 25 });

for await (const chargeback of vatly.chargebacks.listAll()) {
  // ...
}
```

Chargebacks for a specific order are also available via
`vatly.orders.listChargebacks(orderId)` and
`vatly.orders.getChargeback(orderId, chargebackId)` — see [Orders](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/javascript/orders#chargebacks-on-an-order).

## Reacting to disputes

Listen for the `order.chargeback_received` and `order.chargeback_reversed`
webhooks. The delivery's `entityId` is the order id and `object` is the full
Chargeback (incl. the tax breakdown), so you can suspend access and reconcile
the reversed VAT without a follow-up call.


# Webhooks

Vatly sends webhooks to notify your application when events happen — an order being paid, a refund completing, a subscription being canceled. Every delivery is HMAC-signed; the SDK verifies the signature and hands you a typed event.

For event fields and endpoint options, see the [Webhook Events](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/webhook-events){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} and [Webhook Endpoints](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/webhook-endpoints){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} API references. The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.

## Webhook events

The `eventName` field identifies what happened. Names are available as constants
on [`WebhookEventName`](https://github.com/vatly/vatly-api-js/blob/main/src/webhooks/events.ts){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

| Event                                                                        | `object` type    | Description                                                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `order.paid`                                                                 | Order            | Order payment was successful.                                             |
| `order.canceled`                                                             | Order            | Order was canceled.                                                       |
| `order.payment_failed`                                                       | Order            | A payment failed and dunning started.                                     |
| `order.chargeback_received`                                                  | Chargeback       | A chargeback was received for an order.                                   |
| `order.chargeback_reversed`                                                  | Chargeback       | A chargeback was reversed.                                                |
| `refund.completed`                                                           | Refund           | Refund was processed successfully.                                        |
| `refund.failed`                                                              | Refund           | Refund processing failed.                                                 |
| `refund.canceled`                                                            | Refund           | Refund was canceled.                                                      |
| `subscription.started`                                                       | Subscription     | Subscription was started.                                                 |
| `subscription.billing_updated`                                               | Subscription     | Billing details (e.g. the mandate) changed.                               |
| `subscription.canceled_immediately`                                          | Subscription     | Canceled immediately.                                                     |
| `subscription.canceled_with_grace_period`                                    | Subscription     | Canceled; access until period end.                                        |
| `subscription.cancellation_grace_period_completed`                           | Subscription     | Grace period ended.                                                       |
| `subscription.resumed`                                                       | Subscription     | A canceled subscription was resumed.                                      |
| `subscription.canceled_for_nonpayment`                                       | Subscription     | Payment recovery exhausted.                                               |
| `subscription.updated`                                                       | Subscription     | Immediate/scheduled change or renewal; inspect `reason`.                  |
| `subscription.update_scheduled`                                              | Subscription     | Change scheduled; inspect `scheduledUpdate`.                              |
| `one_off_product.update_submitted` / `update_approved` / `update_rejected`   | OneOffProduct    | Product change review lifecycle (each suffix uses the same prefix).       |
| `one_off_product.archived` / `unarchived`                                    | OneOffProduct    | Product availability changed.                                             |
| `subscription_plan.update_submitted` / `update_approved` / `update_rejected` | SubscriptionPlan | Plan change review lifecycle.                                             |
| `subscription_plan.archived` / `unarchived`                                  | SubscriptionPlan | Plan availability changed.                                                |
| `checkout.paid`                                                              | Checkout         | Checkout was paid.                                                        |
| `checkout.failed`                                                            | Checkout         | Checkout payment failed.                                                  |
| `checkout.canceled`                                                          | Checkout         | Checkout was canceled.                                                    |
| `checkout.expired`                                                           | Checkout         | Checkout session expired.                                                 |
| `webhook.setup`                                                              | Webhook          | Verification call sent when an endpoint is registered or its URL changes. |

## Verify and process in one step

`constructWebhookEventFromRequest` reads the raw body and `Vatly-Signature`
header off a Fetch `Request`, verifies the HMAC, and returns a **discriminated**
event. Check `event.known` first, then switch on `event.eventName` to narrow `event.object` to the exact
resource — no casts, no follow-up API call (Vatly sends fat, signed payloads, so
`object` is the full `GET /…/{id}` snapshot).

```ts
import { constructWebhookEventFromRequest } from "@getvatly/sdk/webhooks";

export async function POST(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  let event;
  try {
    event = await constructWebhookEventFromRequest(request, process.env.VATLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET!);
  } catch {
    return new Response("invalid signature", { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!event.known) {
    // Retain the verified envelope durably for triage, then acknowledge it.
    // Until retention succeeds, retry rather than silently losing the delivery.
    return new Response("unsupported event requires triage", { status: 503 });
  }
  switch (event.eventName) {
    case "order.paid":
      event.object.total; // Money — typed as Order
      break;
    case "subscription.billing_updated":
      event.object.mandate; // typed as Subscription
      break;
    case "webhook.setup":
      return new Response("ok"); // verification handshake — just acknowledge
  }
  return new Response("ok");
}
```

If you already have the raw bytes (e.g. a non-Fetch framework), use
`constructWebhookEvent(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret)`. To verify only and
get the raw `WebhookDelivery` envelope, use `constructEvent` /
`constructEventFromRequest`, then narrow later with `toWebhookEvent(delivery)`.

`VatlyWebhookEvent` includes `KnownWebhookEvent` (`known: true`) and
`UnsupportedWebhookEvent` (`known: false`, `eventName: string`, `object: unknown`).
The SDK adds this discriminator to a shallow copy after verification, overwriting
any wire-supplied flag. It classifies the event name, not the resource schema.
Both sides of `if (event.known)` narrow normally; no custom type guards are needed.
Unknown event names can appear before an SDK upgrade. Keep them for triage and
decide acknowledgement policy explicitly; a successful HMAC is not a reason to
discard an event you cannot yet process.

> **Always verify against the raw body bytes.** Re-serializing the JSON changes
> the bytes (whitespace, key order, number formatting) and breaks the HMAC.

## The `webhook.setup` event

When you register a webhook endpoint (or change its URL), Vatly sends a signed
`webhook.setup` call to confirm the endpoint is reachable. It's delivered as a
normal webhook — same envelope, same signature, same `Vatly-Event-Id` header —
so there's nothing special to parse: verify it and return a `2xx`. Its `object`
is the (secret-free) [webhook endpoint](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/webhook-endpoints){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}
config and `links` is omitted (it's not a persisted event).

## Signature scheme

```text
Vatly-Signature: t=1700000000,v1=<hex_hmac_sha256>
Vatly-Event-Id:  webhook_event_Qk8pRtSvWm2NjLhYcZaE
```

- `t` is unix seconds, captured fresh on each delivery attempt.
- `v1` is `HMAC-SHA256("{t}.{rawBody}", webhookSecret)`, lowercase hex.
- The SDK rejects signatures where `|now − t| > 300` seconds by default
  (5-minute clock-skew tolerance). Tune it with `{ toleranceSeconds }`.
- Future algorithm rotation ships `v1=…,v2=…` simultaneously; the SDK verifies
  any version it recognizes and ignores the rest.

## Deduplication is your job

The SDK is stateless — it can't remember which events it has verified. The
clock-skew check bounds how long a leaked signature is replayable, but does not
stop replays inside that window. For full replay defense, dedupe on the
retry-stable, signed `event.id` in your own store after verification. The
`Vatly-Event-Id` header is not signed and is for correlation only:

```ts
const event = await constructWebhookEventFromRequest(request, secret);
const eventId = event.id;
if (await store.has(eventId)) return new Response("ok"); // already processed
```

Record successful processing and deduplication atomically; do not mark an event
complete before its business effects succeed. Concurrent deliveries need a
unique constraint or equivalent transactional claim in your store.

## Manage webhook endpoints

```ts
const endpoint = await vatly.webhookEndpoints.create({
  url: "https://yourapp.com/api/webhooks/vatly",
  secret: process.env.VATLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
  enabledEvents: ["order.paid", "subscription.updated"],
});
await vatly.webhookEndpoints.update(endpoint.id, { enabledEvents: [] }); // dormant
const page = await vatly.webhookEndpoints.list();
await vatly.webhookEndpoints.delete(endpoint.id); // 204
```

Secrets are write-only: store the one you supplied. HTTPS URLs must be unique
within the storefront/mode, with up to five endpoints per mode. New event names
are not automatically subscribed; update `enabledEvents` explicitly.

## Rotating secrets

Every verification helper accepts a single secret or an array. During a
rotation, pass both — the SDK accepts whichever signed the delivery:

```ts
const event = await constructWebhookEventFromRequest(request, [
  process.env.VATLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET_OLD!,
  process.env.VATLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET_NEW!,
]);
```

## Fetching a persisted event

Persisted events are available via the API. Note these are returned as the
`WebhookEvent` shape (`GET /webhook-events/{id}`), which — unlike an inbound
delivery — never includes the `webhook.setup` call and always carries `links`:

```ts
const event = await vatly.webhookEvents.get("webhook_event_abc123");
```


# Getting Started

> **Alpha — under active development. Every alpha release may include breaking changes. Pin exact versions during alpha.**

Create checkouts and manage billing with `@getvatly/fluent` on your server.
Vatly is the European merchant of record for AI, software and digital products.
Install the tested alpha pair:

```sh
npm install --save-exact @getvatly/sdk@0.3.0-alpha.2 @getvatly/fluent@0.1.0-alpha.1
```

## Start a subscription

Use a customer and plan from the key's storefront and mode. Check that the
signed-in user owns the customer before calling this function:

```ts
import { VatlyClient } from '@getvatly/sdk';
import { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function startSubscription(apiKey: string, customerId: string, planId: string) {
  const vatly = new Vatly({
    api: new VatlyClient({ apiKey }),
    redirectUrlSuccess: 'https://app.example.com/billing/return',
    redirectUrlCanceled: 'https://app.example.com/billing/canceled',
  });
  const checkout = await vatly.subscribe({ vatlyId: customerId })
    .toPlan(planId)
    .withQuantity(1)
    .create();
  return checkout.getUrl(); // Redirect the customer's browser to this URL.
}
```

Redirect to the returned URL. Use [webhooks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/webhooks) to confirm payment,
not the return page.

For one-off purchases, use [`checkoutBuilder`](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/checkouts#one-off-or-mixed-purchases).

## Guides

| Task                                      | Guide                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Set keys, redirects, and error handling   | [Configuration](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/configuration)            |
| Connect your database                     | [Core concepts and storage](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/coreconcepts) |
| Link customers to your users              | [Customers and bindings](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/customers)       |
| Sell products or start subscriptions      | [Checkouts](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/checkouts)                    |
| Swap, cancel, resume, or update billing   | [Subscriptions](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/subscriptions)            |
| Open invoice history and billing controls | [Customer portal](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/customerportal)         |
| Verify and process events                 | [Webhooks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/webhooks)                      |
| Read invoices, lines, and reversals       | [Orders](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/orders)                          |
| Test your integration                     | [Testing](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/testing)                        |

For field details, see the [API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.
The [OpenAPI spec](https://docs.vatly.com/openapi.yaml){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} is also available for tooling.


# Customers and bindings

Find or create a Vatly customer for your signed-in user. Wire
[binding storage](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/coreconcepts#billables-and-bindings) first.

## Create and bind

```ts
import type { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function customerFor(vatly: Vatly, hostId: string, email: string) {
  const existing = await vatly.customers.findByHostCustomerId(hostId);
  if (existing) return existing;
  return vatly.customers.createFor(
    hostId,
    { email, name: 'Example Customer' },
    { metadata: { accountId: hostId } },
    { idempotencyKey: `customer-for:${hostId}` },
  );
}
```

`createFor` rejects an already-bound host. The API may return an existing customer
for the email; Fluent checks the binding before attaching it. A binding failure
cannot undo remote creation. Reconcile the customer before retrying.

To link a verified existing customer, use `vatly.customers.attribute(vatlyId, hostId)`.
To create without a host owner, use `createUnattributed(profile, extra?, requestOptions?)`;
it still needs `bindings` to record the ID.

## Read and update identity

```ts
import type { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function updateIdentity(vatly: Vatly, customerId: string) {
  const customer = vatly.customer(customerId);
  await customer.update({ name: null }); // Explicitly clear the display name.
  await customer.sync();                // Refresh the cached API resource.
  return customer.identity();          // { name, email }
}

export async function matchingCustomers(vatly: Vatly, email: string) {
  const ids: string[] = [];
  for await (const customer of vatly.customers.findByEmail(email)) ids.push(customer.id);
  return ids;
}
```

Handles fetch lazily and cache per handle. `model()`, `name()`, and `email()` read
that cache; `sync()` refreshes it. Email lookup searches all cursor pages on the
server. `findOneByEmail` returns the first match or null, not proof of ownership.
Identity updates do not change invoice addresses; use the
[billing-update flow](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/subscriptions#update-billing-details).

## Returning from checkout

`customerIdFromCheckout(checkoutId)` returns an ID or null for a missing customer
or 404; other API errors propagate. `claimCustomerFromCheckout(checkoutId, hostId)`
binds that customer. Verify checkout ownership before calling it: an ID in a return
URL is not proof. See [payment confirmation](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/webhooks).

See [customer portal](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/customerportal) for portal links and the
[Customers API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/customers){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} for field details.


# Checkouts

Create a hosted payment page, then redirect the customer to `checkout.getUrl()`.

## One-off or mixed purchases

```ts
import type { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function buyProduct(
  vatly: Vatly, customerId: string, productId: string, purchaseId: string,
) {
  const checkout = await vatly.checkoutBuilder({ vatlyId: customerId })
    .withItems([{ id: productId, quantity: 2 }])
    .withMetadata({ purchaseId })
    .withLocale('en_US')
    .create({}, { idempotencyKey: `checkout:${purchaseId}` });
  return { id: checkout.id, url: checkout.getUrl() };
}
```

Set both redirect URLs in [configuration](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/configuration), or use
`withRedirectUrlSuccess(url)` and `withRedirectUrlCanceled(url)` on the builder.
`withItems` appends items and supports mixed carts.

## Subscription checkout

```ts
import type { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function startSubscription(
  vatly: Vatly, customerId: string, planId: string, purchaseId: string,
) {
  return vatly.subscribe({ vatlyId: customerId })
    .toPlan(planId)
    .withQuantity(3)
    .withTrialDays(14)
    .create({}, { idempotencyKey: `subscribe:${purchaseId}` });
}
```

`subscribe` makes no request until `create()`, which creates a checkout, not a
subscription. The subscription builder uses one plan; use `checkoutBuilder` for
mixed carts. Quantity and trial days must be positive safe integers. Omit trial
methods for no trial, or use `withTrialEndsAt(date)` to round up to whole days.

## Payloads and retries

Use a new builder per purchase. `payload(overrides?)` returns a detached request
snapshot without calling the API. `create(overrides?, requestOptions?)` returns the
SDK checkout plus `getUrl()`. On plain SDK checkouts, read `links.checkoutUrl.href`.

Persist the purchase ID before calling `create()`. Reuse its idempotency key on
retries; use a new key for a new purchase. Validate customer, product, price, and
redirect overrides on the server rather than passing browser input through.

`inTestmode()` and `inLiveMode()` check the API key's mode; they do not change it.
For a known customer, [create or bind them first](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/customers) and authorize their
ID. An email-only profile does not create a customer. Omit the profile for an
anonymous checkout where the API supports it.

Save the checkout ID. Confirm payment through [webhooks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/webhooks), not the return page.
For product and checkout fields, see the [Checkouts API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/checkouts){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}
and [Subscription Plans](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/subscription-plans){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.


# Subscriptions

Change an existing subscription with `vatly.subscription(localRecord)`. Load and
authorize the record from your [repository](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/coreconcepts); wire that repository
into `Vatly` so swap, resume, and sync can save changes.

## Change plan or quantity

```ts
import type { LocalSubscription, Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function schedulePlan(vatly: Vatly, local: LocalSubscription, planId: string) {
  return vatly.subscription(local).swap(planId, { quantity: 2 });
}

export async function changeAndInvoice(vatly: Vatly, local: LocalSubscription, planId: string) {
  return vatly.subscription(local).swapAndInvoice(planId, { quantity: 2 });
}

export async function changeWithoutCharge(vatly: Vatly, local: LocalSubscription, planId: string) {
  return vatly.subscription(local).swapWithoutCharge(planId);
}
```

Choose one action:

| Method                                 | Options sent to the API                                                 |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `swap(planId, body?, requestOptions?)` | Your update options; without `applyImmediately`, changes are scheduled. |
| `swapAndInvoice(...)`                  | Forces `applyImmediately: true`, `invoiceImmediately: true`.            |
| `swapWithoutCharge(...)`               | Forces `applyImmediately: true`, `prorationCharge: false`.              |

Local plan and quantity follow the API response. A scheduled swap leaves the
current plan unchanged. `scheduledUpdate()` fetches the pending change;
`hasScheduledUpdate()` checks whether one exists. See the API reference below
for proration rules.

## Cancel and resume

```ts
import type { LocalSubscription, Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function cancelNow(vatly: Vatly, local: LocalSubscription, operationId: string) {
  await vatly.subscription(local).cancel({
    immediately: true,
    idempotencyKey: `cancel:${operationId}`,
  });
}

export async function resume(vatly: Vatly, local: LocalSubscription) {
  const handle = await vatly.subscription(local).resume();
  return handle.model();
}
```

`cancel()` uses the API's default timing; `{ immediately: true }` cancels now.
Cancellation waits for [webhooks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/webhooks) to set local `endsAt`. Resume clears
it after the API succeeds. `cancellationReason()` fetches the remote reason.

`model()` returns the local record. `sync()` fetches and saves the API resource.
`state()` derives `active`, `valid`, `recurring`, `cancelled`, `onGracePeriod`, and
`ended` from `endsAt`. Check Vatly's `status` separately for states such as paused.

### Grace-period limitation in 0.1.0-alpha.1

This alpha's `sync()` and cancellation reactions set `endsAt` to
`endedAt ?? canceledAt`. During a grace period, `endedAt` can be null and
`canceledAt` is the cancellation request time, not the access deadline. The local
flags can therefore report an ended subscription while access is still owed.
Keep entitlement decisions separate from `state()` until this is corrected;
confirm the grace deadline before changing access. Do not use `canceledAt` as an expiry.

## Update billing details

```ts
import type { LocalSubscription, Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function billingUpdateUrl(vatly: Vatly, local: LocalSubscription) {
  return vatly.subscription(local).updateBilling({
    redirectUrlSuccess: 'https://app.example.com/billing/updated',
    redirectUrlCanceled: 'https://app.example.com/billing/canceled',
  });
}
```

Redirect to the returned URL; do not log or persist it. This hosted flow updates
billing details, rather than writing address fields directly. Both redirects are
required here or in [configuration](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/configuration). Process
`subscription.billing_updated` to update local payment details.

For all options, eligibility, and fields, see the
[Subscriptions API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/subscriptions){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.


# Orders and invoices

Fetch an order's invoice link, lines, and totals after checking the caller owns it.

## Read the order and invoice

```ts
import type { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function invoice(vatly: Vatly, orderId: string) {
  const order = vatly.order(orderId);
  const model = await order.model();
  return {
    id: model.id,
    status: model.status,
    total: model.total,
    lines: await order.lines(),
    invoiceUrl: await order.invoiceUrl(),
  };
}
```

The handle fetches once and caches the API resource. `sync()` refreshes it.
`invoiceUrl()` returns null if no link exists. These reads need no local order or
line repository. Use [webhooks](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/webhooks) to persist payments and fulfill orders.

## Money and reversals

Use `toMinorUnits` for bigint arithmetic; keep the currency with the amount.

```ts
import { toMinorUnits } from '@getvatly/sdk';
import type { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function reversalSummary(vatly: Vatly, orderId: string) {
  const order = vatly.order(orderId);
  const model = await order.model();
  return {
    totalMinor: toMinorUnits(model.total),
    reversedMinor: await order.reversedSubtotal(),
    refundableMinor: await order.refundableSubtotal(),
    fullyReversed: await order.isFullyReversed(),
    partiallyReversed: await order.isPartiallyReversed(),
  };
}
```

Money uses decimal strings, not floats. Convert bigints to strings before returning
JSON. Reversal predicates read the cached API resource, not local reversal lists.
`isReversed()` includes partial reversals. A paid order stays paid after a reversal.

`order.refunds()` and `order.chargebacks()` read your wired reversal repositories.
Without a driver they return an empty list. Use `vatly.api.orders` and
`vatly.api.refunds` to create refunds or query remote reversals. Check API state
before retrying a refund whose outcome is unknown.

For fields and refund rules, see [Orders](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/orders){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"},
[Order Refunds](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/refunds){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}, and
[Chargebacks](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/chargebacks){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} in the API reference.


# Webhooks

Record payments and subscription changes from signed webhooks, not checkout
redirects. Pass a configured `Vatly` to this Fetch handler, or export the returned
function as a Next.js Route Handler's `POST`:

```ts
import { VatlyInvalidSignatureError } from '@getvatly/sdk';
import { Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export function webhookRoute(vatly: Vatly) {
  return async function POST(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    try {
      const processed = await vatly.webhookProcessor().handleRequest(request);
      return new Response(null, { status: processed ? 201 : 200 });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof VatlyInvalidSignatureError) {
        return new Response('Invalid signature', { status: 400 });
      }
      // Failed storage/reactions must be retried; do not acknowledge success.
      return new Response('Webhook processing failed', { status: 500 });
    }
  };
}
```

Set `webhookSecret`, `webhookCalls`, and the repositories you want updated in
[configuration](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/configuration). This route needs no browser session; signatures
authenticate deliveries. Pass the original unread request, not reserialized JSON.
For raw bytes, use `processor.handle(rawBody, signatureHeader)`.

The SDK checks `Vatly-Signature` HMAC and timestamp before touching storage.
Keep timestamp checks enabled. To rotate secrets, set `webhookSecret` to an array
of accepted secrets.

## Idempotency and one transaction

Implement `WebhookCalls.process(event, work)` in one transaction shared by all
[storage drivers](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/coreconcepts#webhook-storage):

1. Lock or claim the signed `event.id`. If already committed, return false.
2. Retain the verified envelope, including unknown events.
3. Await `work()` to run reactions and dispatch.
4. Mark the ID processed and commit resource changes, bindings, audit, and outbox
   together. Return true. Roll back everything on failure.

Never commit the deduplication row before the work; a failure would lose the retry.
Use signed `event.id`, not the unsigned `Vatly-Event-Id` header. Scope keys and rows
by tenant, storefront, and mode. Timestamp checks alone do not deduplicate.

Write to an outbox in `events.dispatch`. Send email and make network calls from a
worker after commit. Deliveries can arrive out of order; reconcile conflicting
snapshots with the API.

## What Fluent persists

| Event                                                                | Built-in action when the repository is wired                                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subscription.started`                                               | Create or update a local subscription; a new saved row emits `local.subscription_created`.                |
| `subscription.updated`, `subscription.billing_updated`               | Update plan, name, quantity, status, and non-null mandate on an existing row; otherwise skip.             |
| `subscription.resumed`                                               | Update an existing row and clear `endsAt`.                                                                |
| Cancellation events and grace-period completion                      | Update an existing row's `endsAt` and cancellation reason.                                                |
| `order.paid`, `order.payment_failed`                                 | Create or update an order using the signed status; a newly stored paid order emits `local.order_created`. |
| `order.canceled`                                                     | Update status and cancellation reason on an existing order; otherwise skip.                               |
| `refund.completed`, `refund.failed`, `refund.canceled`               | Upsert a refund if `refunds` is wired.                                                                    |
| `order.chargeback_received`, `order.chargeback_reversed`             | Upsert a chargeback if `chargebacks` is wired.                                                            |
| Scheduled subscription updates, catalogue, checkout, `webhook.setup` | Dispatch only; no built-in resource write.                                                                |

Reactions use the signed snapshot without an API GET. Missing repositories skip
writes, not dispatch. Null billing-event mandates leave the local mandate unchanged;
subscription `sync()` reconciles removal.

Before using subscription state to grant or revoke access, read the
[grace-period limitation in this alpha](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/subscriptions#grace-period-limitation-in-010-alpha1).

## Application events and extensions

```ts
import type { DomainEvent, EventDispatcher } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export function billingEvents(
  enqueueInCurrentTransaction: (event: DomainEvent) => Promise<void>,
): EventDispatcher {
  return { dispatch: event => enqueueInCurrentTransaction(event) };
}
```

Check `event.known` before switching on `eventName`. The union includes SDK
deliveries and the two local-created events above. Unknown signed events have
`known: false` and `object: unknown`; retain and dispatch them without built-in
writes. Types do not validate resource fields at runtime.

`additionalWebhookReactions` takes `{ supports(event), handle(event) }` objects.
They run after built-ins and before dispatch, in the same transaction. Throw to
roll back and allow retry.

For event fields, see [Webhook Events](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/webhook-events){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.
Register endpoints using [Webhook Endpoints](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference/webhook-endpoints){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"};
the [webhooks guide](https://docs.vatly.com/guides/webhooks){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"} describes delivery and signatures.


# Installation and configuration

Fluent `0.1.0-alpha.1` requires SDK `0.3.0-alpha.2`. Pin both during alpha:

```sh
npm install --save-exact @getvatly/sdk@0.3.0-alpha.2 @getvatly/fluent@0.1.0-alpha.1
```

Use Node 20+ or a runtime with Fetch and Web Crypto. ESM, CommonJS, and TypeScript
declarations are included. Keep keys and secrets on the server, never in browser
code or `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` variables.

## Create the billing service

Pass your server's `VATLY_API_KEY` to this factory:

```ts
import { VatlyClient } from '@getvatly/sdk';
import { Vatly, type Wiring } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export function createBilling(
  apiKey: string,
  drivers: Omit<Wiring, 'api' | 'redirectUrlSuccess' | 'redirectUrlCanceled'> = {},
) {
  return new Vatly({
    ...drivers,
    api: new VatlyClient({ apiKey, timeoutMs: 15_000, maxRetries: 2 }),
    redirectUrlSuccess: 'https://app.example.com/billing/return',
    redirectUrlCanceled: 'https://app.example.com/billing/canceled',
  });
}
```

`test_` keys select test mode; `live_` keys charge real money. Both use the same
API URL. All IDs and bindings must match the key's storefront and mode.

Checkout creation needs only `api` and redirect URLs. Add [storage drivers](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/coreconcepts)
for bindings, local subscription updates, and webhook persistence. Missing drivers
fail when used. For webhooks, also set `webhookSecret` from `VATLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET`,
the endpoint's signing secret—not the API key.

Use `vatly.api` for SDK operations without a Fluent helper, including catalogue
management, pagination, and webhook endpoints.

## Handle errors and retries

```ts
import { VatlyValidationError } from '@getvatly/sdk';
import { FluentError, type Vatly } from '@getvatly/fluent';

export async function renameCustomer(vatly: Vatly, customerId: string, name: string) {
  try {
    return await vatly.customer(customerId).update({ name });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof VatlyValidationError) {
      return { validationErrors: error.errors };
    }
    if (error instanceof FluentError) throw error; // Fix local input or wiring.
    throw error; // Preserve SDK status, details, and cause for your error handler.
  }
}
```

SDK errors pass through unchanged. Most local input and wiring errors use
`FluentError`; missing billing-update redirects throw a plain `Error` in this alpha.
Reuse an `idempotencyKey` when retrying the same mutation: a timeout does not mean
it failed. See [checkout retries](https://docs.vatly.com/packages/fluent-js/checkouts#payloads-and-retries).

For HTTP options and field details, see the [API reference](https://docs.vatly.com/api-reference){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}
and [errors guide](https://docs.vatly.com/guides/errors){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.


# Core concepts and storage
